title: Review: full project review loop 5
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — 18 P1 issues, 14 P2 issues across all crates. Most critical: IPv6 owner_login (breaks login on IPv6 deployments), advance_state transactionless (data integrity under crash), kithctl hang bugs (DoS from misbehaving daemon), TUI empty-chat crash, test harness split blob stores (hides attachment delivery bugs in tests).
Confidence: 15% chance of missed P0. Uncertainty driven by: advance_state transactional semantics under concurrent load (SQLite serialized mode may make this a non-issue), kith-tui event loop correctness (many async interactions not fully traced), Headscale user_id format compatibility for discovery. Would raise confidence with: a Headscale integration test, IPv6 deployment test, and fuzz testing of the JMAP message parser.
